_comment: Qwen3-TTS voice-design prompts, keyed by the friendly voice name the voice server sends (QWEN3_VOICE_MAP in server.ts). 'instruct' is a natural-language description of the desired voice; no reference audio required.

default.instruct: Warm, articulate adult voice, calm and confident, natural American accent, measured conversational pace.

aurelia.instruct: Warm, articulate adult female voice, calm and self-assured, natural American accent, thoughtful measured pace, subtle friendly energy.

tinkerbelle.instruct: Bright, quick, playful adult female voice, energetic and clever, natural American accent, slightly faster pace, mischievous warmth.

cybill.instruct: Cool, precise adult female voice, dry and analytical, natural American accent, even measured pace, understated authority.

will.instruct: Steady, grounded adult male voice, clear and practical, natural American accent, even pace.

researcher.instruct: Curious, precise adult voice, thoughtful and articulate, natural American accent, measured pace.

analyst.instruct: Neutral, crisp adult voice, factual and composed, natural American accent, even pace.
